reason: Both are industrial manufacturers serving aerospace and defense customers. Crane sells engineered components (sensors, connectors, fluid-handling parts) and process-flow valves and pumps. Textron builds complete aircraft, helicopters, defense systems, golf cars and industrial products. The aerospace and defense end market overlaps. The product does not: Textron has nothing in process-flow valves or pumps, and it is a diversified aircraft and vehicle OEM. It also has a finance segment and consumer-type sales. Overlap in one area only, so adjacent.
